name: DEBUPLUS
source:
VALKYRIA presents... the most unheard-of series ever!
All heroines are fatty chubby plumps with meaty obesity!

Round, piggish, porky, glandular...
Big breasted ham-leg honey butts by any name are still as cute!
It's time to make those big, soft thighs clap with bouncy pleasure!

PREMISE
Ririka Yamamoto confessed she liked him.
Though surprised at her size, he said "yes"...
So began an obsession where meat is inseparable from love.
That is to say, love and flesh are trapped in the same rolls of fat!
The bigger her body grows, the bigger his fetish gets!

Will you tumble into a lewd world of plump fetishism, or chalk a big circle around the girth of "shiawase futori" (fat with love)?

It's your choice! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE069537.html]English DLsite[/url]]

The game title was [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/information.html]officially changed[/url] from "Debu Plus" to "Debutopia" on October 18, 2012, two years after the initial release.
translation:
VALKYRIA呈现…有史以来最闻所未闻的系列！
女主角个个都是肥嘟嘟的肉嘟嘟的肥胖！

圆形、猪形、猪肉形、腺形……
大胸火腿蜜屁股不管叫什么名字都还是那么可爱！
是时候让那些又大又软的大腿充满弹性的快乐拍打起来了！

前提
山本梨香承认她喜欢他。
尽管对她的身材感到惊讶，他还是说“是的”……
于是开始了一种痴迷，肉与爱密不可分。
也就是说，爱情和肉体都被困在同一卷脂肪里了！
她的身体越大，他的恋物癖就越大！

你会跌入一个丰满恋物癖的淫荡世界，还是在“shiawase futori”（因爱而肥胖）的腰围上画一个大圆圈？

这是你的选择！

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE069537.html]英文DLsite[/url]]

游戏名称于2012年10月18日，即首次发布两年后，[url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/information.html]正式更改[/url]，从“Debu Plus”更名为“Debutopia”。
